errors.evidence: The description states that the Precision (blue line) value at mBERT-100 is approximately 89.0%. However, the blue data point at mBERT-100 is visibly below the 89% level (the midpoint between the 88 and 90 gridlines). Its value is closer to 88.8%.
The description states that the Recall (red line) value at mBERT-80 is approximately 89.8%. However, the red data point at mBERT-80 is visibly lower than this, located at approximately 89.5%.

errors.text_span: 蓝色圆点实线表示 Precision（精度），从 mBERT-0 约 81.1% 上升到 mBERT-10 约 83.8%，在 mBERT-30 约 84.1%，到 mBERT-50 约 86.5%，随后在 mBERT-80 约 87.4%，最终在 mBERT-100 约 89.0%；红色圆点实线表示 Recall（召回率），从 mBERT-0 约 83.5% 上升到 mBERT-10 约 85.8%，在 mBERT-30 约 86.6%，到 mBERT-50 约 87.6%，在 mBERT-80 约 89.8%，并在 mBERT-100 达到约 90.5%；绿色圆点实线表示 F1 Score（F1分数），从 mBERT-0 约 82.3% 上升到 mBERT-10 约 84.8%，在 mBERT-30 约 85.3%，到 mBERT-50 约 87.0%，随后在 mBERT-80 约 88.6%，并在 mBERT-100 约 89.7%。
errors.evidence: The description lists the numerical value for every single data point on the chart. This level of detail is excessive and harms readability. A better approach would be to summarize the trend and provide the start and end values for each line, as the reference description does.
